title: In repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/rhythm-conductor-tick.ts, the constant named structuralBreak is currently comp
description: In repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/rhythm-conductor-tick.ts, the constant named structuralBreak is currently computed as: rhythms.length === 0 ? "registry_empty" : mappable === 0 ? "registry_unmappable" : null. The problem is that fetchJson returns null when the registry read fails or times out, and that null is converted into an empty rhythms array, so a FAILED READ is reported as an empty registry and wrongly re-opens a closed gap. Change that single expression so it first checks whether regResp is null and yields null in that case, before the existing rhythms.length === 0 check. Do not add any import. Do not modify any other line or any other function. The change must typecheck.
